Subject: Week 0 kickoff — call schedule, host handoff, and attendee roster

Alex / Priya —

Thanks again for the time earlier. To make Week 0 efficient we want to lock the kickoff schedule and the host/backup rotation so everyone knows who owns each segment (technical access, provisioning, success plan, and escalation). Below is a single-sheet plan and two proposed time options. Please confirm the option that works best for your team and any attendees we should add.

Proposed sessions (single 90-min session OR split into two 45-min blocks, we can do either):
- Option A — Single 90-min: Tue, May 18, 10:00–11:30 PT (best for West Coast teams)
- Option B — Split 45-mins: Tue, May 18, 10:00–10:45 PT + Wed, May 19, 08:00–08:45 PT (to accommodate APAC reviewers)

Core agenda (see attached Week0-Agenda.xlsx for details):
1) Welcome + introductions (10 min) — ownership: Alex (Novus) + Karthik (Redwood)
2) Access & provisioning checklist (20 min) — ownership: Monica (Redwood)
3) Baseline integrations & SSO review (20 min) — ownership: Marissa (Redwood)
4) Performance/latency expectations & routing policy overview (15 min) — ownership: Jonas (Redwood)
5) Q&A and next actions (25 min)

Host rotation & backups (attached Host-Roles.pdf) — proposed: primary host Karthik, backup Monica; primary technical lead Marissa, backup Jonas. We’ll hand off bridge ownership in 15-minute increments to keep the host load low.

Attachments provided for review: Week0-Agenda.xlsx (detailed minute-by-minute plan), Host-Roles.pdf (role matrix), Novus-SOW-ExecSummary.pdf.

Links we’ll include in the calendar invite: Zoom bridge (listed below), shared Drive folder (Week 0 materials), and the HubSpot onboarding record (HS: 1223344).

Can you confirm: 1) preferred option (A or B), 2) attendee list (names + emails), and 3) any timezone constraints (someone who cannot join mornings PT)? If we don’t hear back by end of day Tuesday PDT we’ll tentatively schedule Option A.

Thanks —
